Class GameStateDAO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.persistency.GameStateDAO
public class GameStateDAO extends Object
Data Access Object for persisting and retrieving GameSnapshot instances.

Snapshots are stored as pretty-printed JSON files under the "saves" directory, one file per match, named match_<matchId>.json. All public methods are synchronized to be safe for concurrent access from multiple threads.

Writes use a write-to-temp-then-atomic-move strategy to prevent corrupt save files in the event of a crash mid-write.

  • Method Details

    • save

      public static boolean save(GameSnapshot snapshot)
      Persists a GameSnapshot to disk using an atomic write.

      The snapshot is first written to a temporary file (.json.tmp), then atomically moved to the final destination (.json), replacing any previously saved state for the same match. The temporary file is deleted if an error occurs.

      Parameters:
      snapshot - the game snapshot to save; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the snapshot was saved successfully; false if an I/O error occurred

    • loadAll

      public static List<GameSnapshot> loadAll()
      Loads all saved GameSnapshot instances found in the save directory.

      Intended for use at server startup to resume interrupted matches. Files that cannot be deserialized are logged and skipped; they do not prevent other snapshots from being loaded.

      Returns:
      a list of all successfully loaded snapshots; never null, may be empty if no valid save files are found

    • delete

      public static void delete(int matchId)
      Deletes the save file for the given match ID if it exists.

      Any leftover temporary file for the same match is also removed. Failures to delete are logged but do not throw an exception.

      Parameters:
      matchId - the unique identifier of the match whose save file should be deleted

    • fileFor

      private static File fileFor(int matchId, String extension)
      Builds the File handle for a given match ID and file extension.
      Parameters:

      extension - the file extension to use (e.g. ".json" or ".json.tmp")
      Returns:
      the corresponding File within the save directory
